# Vascue

> Vascue is a Hong Kong health tech company building an AI front desk for healthcare. It answers patient enquiries, books appointments, and prepares insurance claims for clinics and hospitals — 24/7, in 15+ languages — so care teams can focus on patients, not process.

Key facts:

- Company: Vascue (health technology, Hong Kong)
- Product: AI front desk for clinics and hospitals — patient messaging, scheduling, quotation and insurance-claims automation, PDF & image analysis, staff oversight dashboard
- Channels: patients interact over WhatsApp; appointments sync into Cliniko, Nookal, Jane, or Vascue's built-in calendar
- Solutions: physiotherapy clinics, hospitals & departments, allied health practices
- Results: 97% patient satisfaction; 45% reduction in processing time; 110,000+ patient messages handled in a single hospital radiology deployment
- Security: ISO 27001 certified; privacy by design — patient data stays under the clinic's control
- Integrations: official Cliniko connected app (cliniko.com/connected-apps/vascue); Nookal; Jane
- Programs: NVIDIA Inception, Google for Startups, Microsoft for Startups, Meta Tech Partner
- Founders: Calvin Tang (CEO — former radiographer at St. Paul's Hospital, ex-SCMP engineer, ex-Senior Project Manager at Animoca Brands); Michael Fung (CTO — ex-Hong Kong Hospital Authority, AWS-certified with 10 years in IT, co-founder of Tecky Academy)
- Contact: hello@vascue.io · +852 9302 7422 · Hong Kong

## Products

- [AI Front Desk](https://www.vascue.io/products): 24/7 multilingual patient messaging, seamless scheduling, instant quotes, claims automation, staff-override dashboard

## Solutions

- [Physiotherapy clinics](https://www.vascue.io/solutions/physiotherapy): enquiries, bookings, and claims handled while practitioners stay in the treatment room
- [Hospitals & departments](https://www.vascue.io/solutions/hospitals): department-scale patient communication on privacy-first architecture
- [Allied health](https://www.vascue.io/solutions/allied-health): chiropractic, podiatry, TCM, and other practices
